desc: Handheld & powerful, the Waypoint Lithium Ion Rechargeable spotlight offers high, medium and low intensity modes, and the latest in power LED technology. The spotlight provides portability and long runtime using a rechargeable lithium ion battery making the Waypoint Lithium Ion the perfect choice for a variety of applications. Weight balanced design virtually eliminates user hand fatigue and the light will float if dropped into water for easy retrieval.
